scope: Non-blind engineering audit; no production promotion, signed gold change or live university fact certification

candidates.title: Require corroborated university site identity
candidates.evidence_limit: Synthetic unrelated-site titles are accepted; independently adjudicated real negative pages needed.

candidates.title: Carry explicit requested programme and degree into eligibility
candidates.evidence_limit: Synthetic wrong-programme claim hard-filters; upstream live reachability is unproven and existing adapter guards must remain.

candidates.title: Prefer exact institution names and aliases in explicit queries
candidates.evidence_limit: Full500 replay: current top-one471/500; development post-sort500/500; result sets unchanged. No production patch or held-out success.

candidates.title: Unify country and region meanings across retrieval and scoring
candidates.evidence_limit: Actual code disagree under synthetic region/alias profiles; keep approved scores and weights unchanged.

candidates.title: Reserve and measure budgets for identity programme discovery and verification
candidates.evidence_limit: Serial ordering and late search can exhaust a case before useful work; frozen historical and synthetic evidence only.

candidates.title: Stop further provider queries after quota failures
candidates.evidence_limit: Synthetic429 currently consumes all six query attempts; no real exhausted-provider requests made in this audit.

candidates.title: Retain stage trace on interruption and mark research not attempted
candidates.evidence_limit: Synthetic timeout loses inner trace; outside-live-window candidates lack a not-attempted limitation.

candidates.title: Reuse verified discovery routes with complete cache provenance
candidates.evidence_limit: Successful identity persistence does not itself create a reusable programme route. Cache provenance needs targeted controls.

candidates.title: Normalize supported country aliases and orthographic forms in explicit queries
candidates.evidence_limit: Country aliases work in filters but can fail in free text; mechanical query variants need independently collected user-query evaluation.

candidates.title: Expand explicit multilingual programme evidence with negative controls
candidates.evidence_limit: Synthetic translated degree and page-shape gaps are hypothesis evidence, not confirmed university-site failure rates.

candidates.title: Measure supported scoped current facts alongside existing reference metrics
candidates.evidence_limit: Synthetic scorer examples show reference recall does not imply joint support/currentness; acceptance gate explicitly documents its scope. Preserve old scores and signed corpus, add separate adjudicated metrics and attempted-case manifest.
